text:
sam_infra: heads-up eu-west1 GPU nodes failing to fetch instance profile creds after microseg rollout. kubelet get-token calls to metadata proxy return 403s.
anya_sre: saw warm-pool stuck in JOIN_PENDING, allocator backlog ~42 pods. nodes show repeated 403 from iam-proxy (token_fetch denied)
deploy-bot: rollout applied 2026-06-02T03:10Z -> role-boundary microsegmentation policy (CHG-2026-0602-MSG)
nora_security: policy tightened roleBoundary on instance profiles; we expected service accounts to call via role-assume proxy but looks like metadata proxy mapping missed gpu-node-role
sam_infra: minimal repro from a stuck node: `curl -s -D- http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/` -> 403 Forbidden with JSON {"message":"role boundary denied"}
anya_sre: keystore and KMS calls also intermittently failing because nodes can't get short-lived creds; auditshipper started retrying PutObject and spiking S3 writes
audit-bot: auditshipper PutObject retry rate x2.7 between 03:10-03:28. est incremental S3 cost ~$640
mike_platform: NATGW conntrack low (this is internal). root cause looks purely IAM role binding and metadata proxy allowlist mismatch
nora_security: whoops. migration config used new roleBoundary conditions and we accidentally excluded ASG tag `gpu-pool=nv4` from the allow mapping. rolling a hotfix to include that tag now
sam_infra: temporary mitigation: added node IAM exception mapping for gpu-pool ASGs at 03:22Z. warm-pool started recovering +22 nodes by 03:29
anya_sre: impact summary: ~65 node-minutes delayed capacity, several large jobs requeued to other regions -> transient latency for affected customers
billing: please tag the S3 spike under BILL-2026-0602-AUDIT for chargeback. Need exact put counts
ora_security: action items: 1) patch roleBoundary mapping to include `gpu-pool=nv4` (nora) 2) add metadata-proxy smoke test in rollout pipeline (mike) 3) add auditshipper circuit-breaker to prevent S3 storm (anya) 4) update microseg rollout runbook to include ASG-tag verification (sam)
mike_platform: decision: keep microseg in staging, pause further prod rollouts until mapping tests added. CHG-2026-0602 updated to paused
ora_security: will add unit test that validates ASG tag inclusion against live inventory and run the policy validator in a dry-run against eu-west1 ASGs
anya_sre: I'll draft a short postmortem and put numbers: 65 node-minutes lost, ~22 recovered warm-joins, S3 retry cost ~$640. tagging for follow-ups
sam_infra: thanks team :thumbsup: close when roleBoundary patch is in prod and auditshipper PR merged
